title: A SCAM! BEWARE!!!
body: Warning!!! This app is a straight up scam!!!! It will not notify you before your trial is up, and will just take your money whether you like it or not. It’s been cleverly designed to rob you whether you care to use the app or not. And the app does not allow refunds!!! It’s such nonsense. I have no idea why it has so many good reviews but I’m guessing they were bought or faked. Buyers beware.
